name: telegram-plus
description: Telegram channel for Claude Code as a bridge to tg-adapter, which polls the bot and sends. This server reads no token and opens no Telegram connection: events-store rows become channel events (event_id, receipts, one redelivery) and tool calls become outbox rows (11 tools: reply with rich text, buttons and files, edit, react, draft, chat action, poll, location, pin, delete, menu commands, downloads; optional urgent, buttons[].bind and approval fields). Also a local voice inbox (127.0.0.1 hand-offs from the live-voice relay and the phone app). One bridge per session (lease).
